source.method: Live Windows SendInput/MSAA automation + ExtendScript DOM readback

moveDrag.shiftConstraint: axis lock ONLY to H or V (NO 45 deg diagonal): if |dx| >= |dy| then dy=0 else dx=0
moveDrag.arrowNudge: Arrow = 1 px in comp space; Shift+Arrow = 10 px
moveDrag.marqueeDrag: selects all layers intersected by marquee rectangle
moveDrag.autoKeyframe: when Position stopwatch is on (numKeys >= 1) and playhead is at a new time, drag automatically creates a new keyframe at comp.time

boundingBoxScale.pivot: ALWAYS pivots around the layer Anchor Point (Layer.Position NEVER changes), regardless of whether Anchor is centered or off-center
boundingBoxScale.shiftCorner: uniform scale using max(|sx|, |sy|) preserving sign
boundingBoxScale.edgeHandle: 1D scale along edge axis only; dragging past anchor flips sign (negative Scale)
boundingBoxScale.handleHitRadiusPhysicalPxAt150Dpi: 6..9 px (hit at 6px inside edge, miss at 10px inside edge; ~5-6 logical DIP)

rotationTool.pivot: layer Anchor Point / Position in comp space
rotationTool.freeDrag: deltaDeg = atan2(curr - pivot) - atan2(start - pivot) clockwise positive
rotationTool.autoKeyframe: when Rotation stopwatch is on and playhead is at a new time, drag automatically creates a keyframe at comp.time

panBehindAnchorTool.formula: Layer.Position += dComp; Layer.AnchorPoint += inv(M_layer_linear) * dComp (visual image in comp remains completely stationary)
panBehindAnchorTool.shiftConstraint: H/V axis lock while dragging anchor
panBehindAnchorTool.snapping: when Snapping (对齐) is ON, snaps Anchor Point to the layer's own 9-point bounding box features (corners, edge midpoints, center)

centerAnchorShortcuts.ctrlAltHome: centers Anchor Point to sourceRect center while compensating Position so visual placement does not move
centerAnchorShortcuts.ctrlDoubleClickPanBehindIcon: exact same result as Ctrl+Alt+Home (verified on Shape Layer: A=[0,0],P=[960,540] -> A=[-360,-190],P=[600,350])

centerInCompShortcut.ctrlHome: moves Layer.Position to [comp.width/2, comp.height/2] without changing Anchor Point

toolbarSubTogglesZh: 沿扩展到图层边界以外的边缘对齐
对齐并显示折叠合成和文本图层内的特性
snapping.grabbedFeatureSemantics: snaps the layer feature handle (9-point: 4 corners, 4 edge midpoints, center/anchor) NEAREST to the mouse-down point on the dragged layer, NOT all edges simultaneously
snapping.snapTargets: other visible layers' 9-point bounding box features (corners, edge midpoints, center/anchor); does NOT snap to comp center or comp edges when no guides are present
snapping.ctrlTempInvert: holding Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) mid-drag temporarily ENABLES snapping when checkbox is OFF, and temporarily DISABLES snapping when checkbox is ON
snapping.thresholdAt150DpiZoom1: snaps at <= 20 physical px (~13.3 DIP), does NOT snap at 24 physical px (~16 DIP)
